plugin.note: Dwarves and Black Guards are low-Defence humanoids; any melee weapon works. The free-to-play Dwarven Mine holds the densest dwarf cluster (36 spawns), making it the fastest place to complete the task.

requirements: Combat level 6 is required to be assigned Dwarves.
Black Guards count toward the task; the level 25 form is on Ice Mountain and the level 48 form is in Keldagrim.
mechanics: Dwarf: combat level 10, 16 Hitpoints, max hit 2 (stab), 5-tick attack speed, Defence level 6 (magic defence +5, all other bonuses 0).
Black Guard (level 25): 30 Hitpoints, max hit 3, Defence level 20 with small melee bonuses.
None of the dwarves are undead, so the salve amulet does not apply.
No elemental weakness is documented for dwarves; melee is the safe default.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill dwarves in the free-to-play Dwarven Mine with any melee weapon.
steps: Enter the Dwarven Mine beneath Ice Mountain / Falador (36 spawns).
Attack dwarves with any melee weapon; the low Defence makes weapon choice unimportant.
Black Guards on Ice Mountain or in Keldagrim also count toward the task.
notes: The Dwarven Mine is free-to-play and central, making it the fastest option.

methods.label: Ranged or Magic
methods.summary: Use Ranged or Magic to clear dwarves while training those skills.
requiredOrKeyItems: A ranged weapon and ammunition, or spell runes
steps: Travel to any dense dwarf spawn (Dwarven Mine, Ice Mountain).
Attack from range; the dwarves' low Hitpoints make kills quick.
Avoid Magic against dwarves specifically, which carry a small +5 magic defence bonus.
notes: Ranged is the better non-melee option given the dwarf +5 magic defence bonus.
